note: RISK-ONLY CHECK — NOT VERIFIED. Tooling failure during this run: web_search returned 'Connection refused' (searx backend down) on all attempts; DuckDuckGo HTML returned 403; Google returned a redirect/consent stub; Bing returned wholly unrelated results (Microsoft, zhihu, credit-union pages) for every query, i.e. the proxy is not honouring the query. Company-data aggregators (zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com) returned 403 and IndiaMART returned 429. Consequently NO sanctions screening (OFAC SDN / UN / EU / UK / BIS Entity List), NO Indian court/party-role check (e.g. eCourts, NCLT), NO regulator-action or negative-news check, and NO credit-rating check could be performed. All fields are therefore null because they are unverified, NOT because they were checked and found clean — do not read null as 'no hit'. The only page successfully retrieved is the company's own website https://seemsanpumps.com/ (footer: 'Copyright © 2022 Seemsan Pumps and Equipments Pvt. Ltd.', contact seemsanmum@gmail.com, +91-9223477016), which self-describes as a manufacturer of polypropylene/PVDF/PTFE/PFA-lined and stainless/super-alloy chemical process pumps, 'sold all over India and Exported to various countries'. Per project rule 5 this is a self-declaration only: status 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no named export destination, no customs/B-L record, no buyer, no date. No evidence of supplies to Russia or the CIS was found, but absence of evidence here is an artefact of the failed search, not a finding. Note also the site gives no registered address, CIN or PAN, so even the Maharashtra/Nashik-area location is unconfirmed from retrieved sources. Per rule 2, nothing here would be a rejection ground regardless. RECOMMENDATION: re-run this company's risk screen when search is restored; treat sanctions/court/rating as OPEN, not cleared.
